title: DENDRAL-64 — Part I: Notational Algorithm for Tree Structures
summary: Joshua Lederberg's DENDRAL-64 technical report, Part I, was published on December 15, 1964. The report documents a system for computer construction, enumeration and notation of organic molecules as tree structures and cyclic graphs, with Part I devoted to a notational algorithm for tree structures.
significance: A dated primary-source documentation milestone for DENDRAL-64 that predates LINEAiGE's existing April 1965 DENDRAL machine-induction memo record. This record documents the 1964 technical report and does not treat its publication date as the invention date, first implementation date, or birth of the later heuristic DENDRAL system.

verification.note: NASA Technical Reports Server identifies Joshua Lederberg as author, Stanford University as affiliation, the publication date as December 15, 1964, report number NASA-CR-57029, and the report subject as computer construction, enumeration and notation of organic molecules. A 1965 Lederberg paper preserved by the U.S. National Library of Medicine cites DENDRAL-64 and NASA CR 57029 as a 1964 work. LINEAiGE records only this dated documentation/publication milestone and does not infer an invention date, first implementation date, system-birth date, geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or additional relationships.
